channel.title: hCaptcha incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from hCaptcha's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Enterprise: Analytics queries under maintenance [resolved]
item.description: Query service maintenance is now complete.

item.title: Increased 429 rates on several ASNs [resolved]
item.description: 429 rates on several networks briefly increased for approximately 60 seconds. This issue has now been resolved.

item.title: Increased error rate on API loads [resolved]
item.description: Between 14:15 UTC and 14:22 UTC, some loads of API assets returned 403s in some regions. This incident has now been resolved.

item.title: Increased latency on API calls in some regions [resolved]
item.description:
We are monitoring sporadic latency impact related to network-level issues at an upstream WAF provider: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/dz87vqwvl8wr
This appeared to primarily affect some LATAM and EUR region POPs.

item.title: hCaptcha is completely unaffected by the AWS outages [resolved]
item.description:
This notice is purely informational.
There was zero impact to hCaptcha from the AWS us-east-1 outage that took down many other online services this week.

item.title: Elevated P99 times in South America (Brazil) regions [resolved]
item.description: Due to an issue at an upstream edge CDN, P99 times in several regions, primarily GIG and GRU, were elevated between 14:15 UTC and 14:45 UTC.

item.title: Elevated latency in IAD region for connections from AWS us-east-1 [resolved]
item.description: We are no longer seeing elevated latency in IAD.
